title: Page search opens with the 'Search or ask a question' box
permissions_required: Any signed-in user of the ShopView App. Whether search results are scoped by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Some sample work orders, customers, assets, parts and vendors exist.
steps: 1. From anywhere in the app, open the page search (the Search box in the top bar, or press Command-K / Ctrl-K).
2. Look at the search panel that opens.
expected: 1. A search panel opens with an empty search box at the top.
2. The box shows the placeholder text 'Search or ask a question' with a magnifier icon on the left and a clear (X) button on the right.
3. Behaviour to confirm — pending Branko's product write-up; to be checked live once the feature is available. (whether 'ask a question' means an AI search — this is out of scope for now).
notes: Design-only. The 'ask a question' placeholder implies AI, which is out of scope; confirm live once available. OVERLAP: this page-search / Command-K component is also covered by the Global Search project (86 cases already authored there, currently postponed). Reconcile / de-duplicate with Global Search before any TestRail push so the same component is not tested twice.

expected: 1. Results are grouped by type with a count next to each group heading, for example 'Work orders (2)', 'Customers (2)', 'Vendors (1)', 'Assets (2)', 'Parts (1)'.
